questions.questionText:
Two statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III.
Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with
commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the
statements.
Statements: 
Some chilies are potatoes.
Some potatoes are onions.
…
Conclusions:
I. Some onions are chilies. 
II. Some onions are potatoes. 
III. No onion is chilly.
options: Conclusion II and either conclusion I or III follow.
Only conclusions I and II follow.
Only conclusions II and III follow.
Conclusion I and either conclusion II or III follow.
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by Staff Selection Commission is Option (A).
